-E.Name: -E
-E.description: Interpret regular expressions followed by -regex and -iregex primaries as extended

-H.Name: -H
-H.description: Cause the file information and file type returned for each symbolic link specified to be those referenced by the link

-L.Name: -L
-L.description: Cause the file information and file type returned for each symbolic link to be those of the file referenced by the link

-P.Name: -P
-P.description: Cause the file information and file type returned for each symbolic link to be those for the link itself

-X.Name: -X
-X.description: Permit find to be safely used in conjunction with xargs

-d.Name: -d
-d.description: Cause find to perform a depth-first traversal

-f.Name: -f
-f.description: Specify a file hierarch for find to traverse

-s.Name: -s
-s.description: Cause find to traverse the file hierarchies in lexicographical order

-x.Name: -x
-x.description: Prevent find from descending into directories that have a device number different than that of the file from which the descent began
